scope: one label-free synthetic numerical/gradient audit; no new model training, raw data or source/dev/test truth access
model: Y_c=mu_c+loading_c*z+sigma_c*eps_c for46frame paths, one shared z~N(0,1), independent iid unitGaussian innovations acrossframes/channels conditional on z. Units are cents/dBFS, not inverse-exponentiated power/Hz. Finite mask probabilities may depend on z through softmax(logits+slopes*z). Innovations do not select masks in this restricted toy law.
decoder: For each valid mask (>=23pitchframes), condition on sharedfactor z; pitch selected samplevariance and full46frame dBFS samplevariance are conditionally independent scaled noncentralchi-square (ddof1). Multiply their conditionalCDFs, weight maskprobabilities and integratez. Invalidmask contributesallfalse9rules. This is not product of unconditional marginalCDFs or conditioning on an observed actual futuremask.

integration.kind: positive Gauss-Legendre integration of normal-density-weighted conditional probabilities on[-8,8]
integration.restriction: onefactoronly; no claim of scalability to highrank latent laws

weight_convention: No conditional-domain renormalization. If rounded GL normal weights sum above1, scale down to1 and report raw sum/scale. Omitted forward mass is assigned toallfalse rule pattern. Invalid masks stay in the full softmax denominator. Normal tail bound applies to forward probability, not automatically to gradient tails.
concrete_fixtures: t=linspace(0,1,46); h=(t-mean(t))/std(t,ddof1). central:mu0,loading0,sigma[.7,1.1],fullmask. drift:mu[1.5*t,.8*sin(2pi*t)],loading0,sigma[.3,.4],fullmask. shared:mu0,loading[.8*h,.8*h],sigma[.5,.5],fullmask. mask:mu[4*t,0],loading[.15*h,.3*h],sigma[.35,.4],masks full/first23/first22,logitslog([.4,.4,.2]),slopes[.3,-.3,0]. invariance:sharedcase+meanframeconstants[13,-7],loadingframeconstants[3,-2]. guardedge usescentralpaths withonlyfirst22orfirst23 mask.
derivative: CPUfloat64 customautograd for noncentralchi-squareCDF: dF/dx=pdf; dF/dnc=.5*(F_df+2-F_df). df constant. Broadcast gradients use Torch expansion. No GPU/higher-order-gradient claim.
fixed_thresholds: central pitch[.4,.7,1.0],power[.6,1.1,1.6]; drift/sharedfactor pitch/power[.4,.8,1.2]; mask pitch[.6,.9,1.3],power[.2,.3,.5]
reference: independently calculate centered path sample std ddof1 from shared joint Gaussian paths with scrambledSobol46x2+1 dimensions; powers14and16, seeds0and1. Integrate all finite masks with their declared conditional probabilities rather than observed future labels. This is empirical numerical comparison, not a certified QMC error bound.
reference_acceptance: For each central/drift/shared/mask fixture compare order512 decoder against ALLfour fixedQMC matrices; the maximum absolute discrepancy must be<=.01. Report each reference and power/seed, no reference selection. Analytic checks usecentral/drift independent channel laws.
gradient_cases: ncCDF df22/45, nc0/.5/8/80, x atfixedcentral/middle/tail points; path amplitude, lognoise, masklogit finite differences with order256. Zero-nc uses one-sided derivative. Relative tolerance evaluated with an absolute5e-6 floor. No arbitraryindicatormontecarlo pathwise-gradient claim.
gradient_acceptance: For every declared scalar check abs(autograd-FD)<=5e-6+5e-4*abs(FD). Pathcases theta=[amplitude,logsigma_pitch,first_masklogit] at [.5,log(.4),0],[1,log(.6),.7],[0,log(.5),-.3]; mu=[3*a*t,.2*sin2pi*t],loadings[.25h,.35h],sigma_power.4,masks asmaskfixture, logits[firstlogit,0,-1],slopes[.3,-.3,0]. Differentiate weighted9probability sum with weights1..9 dividedby45. Gradients target the truncated quadrature implementation; no certified omitted gradient-tail bound.
outcome: Pass only supports numerical feasibility inside the restricted toy law. Failure is reported without rescue. Either result requires new hypothesis/contract before real-data learning. No novelty or independent forecasting improvement follows from synthetic agreement.
